Use built-in names such as openai, anthropic, google, github_private, and ollama, or custom shared credential service names saved through the dashboard or API. This setting only affects tools that actually run inside isolated workers. It never injects provider env vars such as OPENAI_API_KEY. For worker-routed tools, it only controls which shared credentials MindRoom may load inside isolated workers, and it does not affect local shared-only integrations such as homeassistant because those stay in the main runtime.
